arm_descriptions.charge_asap: evaluation/metrics.py::charge_asap_schedule, the uncontrolled rule the paper has always used as the cost-reduction denominator and has never scored as a row.
arm_descriptions.evagent: agent/run.py::run_agent_from_text: parse the request text, call the CVXPY tool, answer behind the five-condition verification gate.
arm_descriptions.llm_only:chain_of_thought: Same input and budget as the structured arm, plus a reasoning section.
arm_descriptions.llm_only:structured: No tools. The schedule and the answer are generated as text.
arm_descriptions.optimum: The LP solved directly on the structured ground-truth day. The reference row: the cost gap it reports is zero by construction and it never reads the request text.

banner: Real frozen ACN days. These traces are the evidence behind the reported numbers and belong in the repository.

pending_arms.plan_act: the Plan-and-Act row is waiting on the same scope decision as ReAct. Registered here so naming it is an error rather than a silently absent row.
pending_arms.react: the ReAct row is waiting on a scope decision that is not the harness's to take (notes repo, diseno_comparacion_pfagent.md section 8). Registered here so naming it is an error rather than a silently absent row.
